title: Auto Indent should use 2 indent levels on continuation lines
body:
## Expectation
Quoting the official documentation: 

> Use 2 indent levels to distinguish continuation lines from regular code blocks.
> ...
> Exceptions to this rule are arrays, dictionaries, and enums. Use a single
indentation level to distinguish continuation lines
([GDScript style guide: L145-169](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-docs/blob/ef4eeeb6063b2bf84ac4be813d5fa0e7b4778508/tutorials/scripting/gdscript/gdscript_styleguide.rst?plain=1#L145-L169))


### Actual

Auto Indent indiscriminately applies 1 indent level for continuation lines.

## Solution

I'm not fussed whether Auto Indent changes to match the docs or vice versa, but to close the issue Auto Indent should replicate the documented **good** examples.

Updating the docs is simpler (I could do it) and would simplify the style guide. If the choice is to change Auto Indent then it's a bit out of scope for me atm.

## Steps to reproduce

Copy and paste the **good** example in the docs:

```gdscript
effect.interpolate_property(sprite, "transform/scale",
		sprite.get_scale(), Vector2(2.0, 2.0), 0.3,
		Tween.TRANS_QUAD, Tween.EASE_OUT)
```

Call Auto Indent and watch it turn into the **bad** example in the docs:

```gdscript
effect.interpolate_property(sprite, "transform/scale",
	sprite.get_scale(), Vector2(2.0, 2.0), 0.3,
	Tween.TRANS_QUAD, Tween.EASE_OUT)
```
